ways.label: Slapjack Saddle Track to Felton Road car park

start.name: top of Young Australian Historic Reserve
start.quote: starts at the top of the Young Australian Historic Reserve

evidence: It continues on to Felton Road car park via Long Gully Loop Track and Bannockburn Sluicings Track.
Follow this for 4.5 km to a junction in the road and the start of the Slapjack Saddle Track.

doubts: Start is a junction on the 4WD road at the top of the reserve; no feature matches. Page notes that during lambing closure (1 Oct-30 Nov) you return via the Young Australian Historic Reserve Road; not recorded as a separate way.
